meta.description: Barrington movers for homes with antiques, art and fragile pieces. White glove handling, full packing and our own crews and trucks. Get a free quote.

overview: Some Barrington moves are really about a few things that can't be replaced: an old dresser, framed art, a piano. Those set the pace for the whole job.
We plan the packing around them first and fit the rest of the house in after.
sellingPoints: White glove handling for fragile pieces

servicesBlock.h2: Careful Moving Services for Barrington Homes
servicesBlock.intro: White glove handling and full packing are where Barrington moves tend to need extra care. The same crew covers the residential move itself, piano moving, storage while a house is being finished, and long distance moves if you're relocating out of state. Not sure whether a piece needs special handling? Photograph it and send it with your quote request.

whyChoose.h2: What Barrington Homes With Heirlooms Get From Us

cards.title: Fragile Pieces First
cards.text: We ask about antiques, art and glass when we quote, so the crew arrives with the materials it needs instead of improvising on the day.

cards.title: Every Piece Wrapped
cards.text: Each item of furniture is wrapped before it leaves the room, then strapped inside the truck so nothing shifts on the road.

cards.title: Packing by the Room
cards.text: Choose full packing or just the china cabinet and the bookshelves. Boxes and packing supplies are charged per item used.

cards.title: Pianos Planned Ahead
cards.text: A piano needs a plan for stairs and doorways. Tell us the type and the route out of the house, and we'll quote it with the rest.

faqHeading: Barrington Questions About Moving Valuable Items

faq.q: What does white glove moving include for a Barrington home?
faq.a: Extra care for fragile, valuable or awkward pieces: more wrapping, careful carrying and placement in the new room. Ask the manager to list exactly what applies to your items.

faq.q: How should I prepare antiques before the crew arrives?
faq.a: Empty the drawers and point out anything loose, cracked or already repaired. The crew wraps the piece, but knowing its weak spots helps them carry it.

faq.q: Can you move framed art and large mirrors?
faq.a: Yes. Mention each large frame or mirror when you request the quote so the crew brings enough padding and plans how to carry them.

faq.q: Do you charge for the wrapping on a Barrington move?
faq.a: Not separately on a local move. Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and truck costs (gas, mileage, tolls) are included in the hourly rate, while boxes are charged per item.

faq.q: The new house is still being finished. Can you hold our furniture?
faq.a: Yes. Your things go into storage and are delivered once the house is ready. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faqClosing: More detail on handling, booking and payment is on our FAQ page.

closing.body: Tell us about the pieces you care about most, along with the addresses and date. The quote will show how each one gets handled.
